claim: Locate actual descriptor-pencil modes in the frequency bands where same-grid Radau paths disagree; distinguish a resolved high-frequency response from arithmetic error before another solver or any refinement.
decision: Use only mode residuals and source projections to choose the next propagator. Do not turn a mode sample into a complete error certificate or rerun time paths.
forecast: The full24000-variable banded factorization is already measured in the6s64-step paths. New Arnoldi iterations are unmeasured; cap90s, no additional shifts after cap or failure.
limitations: Sampled modal bands, nonsymmetric pencil; retain complex or growing eigenvalues and report residuals, never force a real/stable spectrum.
